events.credibility_reason: F5: claims a proof of RH (landmark) with no expert uptake in ~5 months; non-standard self-styled framework ('LCK Algebra', 'wheel algebra' absorbing element, 'holographic extension'); not on arXiv; the live Wikipedia article and later bound-lowering works (Gomila, Raymond) treat Λ as undetermined.

judgement.doubts: Both bounds are unreviewed self-published works; Romik's review of Gomila is in progress only. Raymond's AI quote ('developed with AI assistance') is thin (F9) and does not say what the AI produced; kept 'assisted' because both events in the window describe AI as part of the development, not only checking. Gomila's four-agent review panel is checking and alone would be 'none'. If Raymond's bound fails, the status falls back to Gomila's bound, still progress.

outcome_prefix: Raymond's September 2026 Zenodo/GitHub deposit lowers the unconditional upper bound to Λ < 0.149396, superseding Gomila's 0.1787854; both are unreviewed bounds and Λ stays undetermined.
